scenicChapters.title: Klausen Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1948 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Klausen Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: For 23 km this is Klausen Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

klausen-pass.story: 82 km one way from Altdorf - plan on about 1 h 24 of riding. It goes by way of Klausen Pass and Urnerboden. The highest point is about 1,950 m. Klausen Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
